# Agent-Friendly Services

> Find services for user tasks and compare access requirements, reviewed outcomes, token usage, estimated model costs and service charges.

## Query

- [Catalog JSON](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Olorinm/agent-friendly-services/main/generated/catalog.json): classification tree, outcome capabilities, services, access routes, personal eligibility, published costs and route-specific task observations.
- [Results JSON](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Olorinm/agent-friendly-services/main/generated/evaluations.json): frozen tasks, outcomes, run conditions, tokens, service charges and evidence paths.
- [MCP setup and parameters](./mcp/README.md): `search_services` filters candidates; `get_service` returns full service details.
- Example: `search_services({"classification":"travel/flights"})`, then `get_service({"id":"kiwi"})`.
- Financial example: `search_services({"classification":"web-search-data/financial-data/fx","capability":"fx.history"})`. Parent paths include descendants; `subcategory` remains an alias. Types are classifications, deliverable outcomes are capabilities, API/MCP/CLI are access attributes. Search (`web.search`) does not imply URL extraction (`web.fetch`).
- Task observations carry current `classification` and `phase` (`setup` or `business`), without modifying historical prompts or results. Scoped queries do not transfer parent setup or another class’s results into a business outcome.

Start with the user's domain and constraints. Inspect candidate routes and relevant task records before recommending a service. Report why it fits, access requirements, observed results, costs, evidence dates and unresolved gaps. Read `access_links` for selected API/SDK/CLI/MCP setup documentation (the same links shown on the homepage). Concrete endpoints and other discovery URLs remain in `catalog.routes[].entry_url`; route-specific instructions are in `docs`. Missing documentation does not mean the route is unavailable.

A documented route is not a task pass. Results apply only to the recorded route, task/version and setup; unknown costs are not zero. Cached input tokens are included in input totals. Model costs are automatically estimated using a dated LiteLLM pricing snapshot; service charges retain reported/free/estimated/unknown provenance. Summary usage and costs are means over valid trials, including failures; any missing value makes that mean unknown. Compare identical task sets, repetitions and configurations. Setup outside the measured run is disclosed separately. Do not infer a general ranking from isolated trials or contact/register with a provider merely to query this directory.
